## Classes

### GitStepMaterialError

Permanent continuation failure: background owners settle their lane instead of
retrying it.

#### Extends

- `Error`


### GitStepSql

```ts
type GitStepSql = Readonly<{
  exec: {
    toArray: readonly Readonly<
      Record<string, string | number | ArrayBuffer | null>
    >[];

```

Existing facet SQLite owner; no transaction or scheduler is introduced here.

---

### GitStep

```ts
type GitStep = z.output<typeof gitStepSchema>;
```

Durable checkpoint, suitable for a Watchdog payload and fresh-frame
re-admission.

---

### GitStepOperation

```ts
type GitStepOperation =
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "commit";
      requestKey: string;
      request: CommitFilesRequest;
      tags?: readonly Readonly<{
        ref: string;
        expected: string | null;
      }>[];
      timestamp?: number;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "merge";
      requestKey: string;
      request: MergeBranchRequest;
      timestamp?: number;
    }>;
```

Caller-owned operation; begin fixes the timestamp and stores file bytes outside
the checkpoint.

---

### GitStepOutcome

```ts
type GitStepOutcome =
  | GitWriteOutcome
  | GitMergeOutcome
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "too_large";
    }>;
```

Final Git outcome; oversize material refuses before any receive-pack.

---

### GitStepResult

```ts
type GitStepResult =
  | Readonly<{
      next: GitStep;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      done: GitStepOutcome;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      yield: true;
    }>;
```

One step either checkpoints, settles, or yields before transport.

---

### GitStepPorts

```ts
type GitStepPorts = Readonly<{
  git: GitCommitStore;
  material: GitStepMaterial;
}>;
```

Per-frame transport plus the existing facet's durable material owner.
